name: invook
description: An open-source, AI-native Gmail client that labels your inbox automatically.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:local-reset && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:local-reset: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions docker/reset-local-config.ts docker/reset-local-config.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:local-reset && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
